description: This file defines an abstract class `BaseModuleActivator` which implements the `ModuleActivator` interface. It provides empty implementations for lifecycle methods related to module activation, such as starting, stopping, and refreshing contexts. The class is meant to be extended by modules to customize behavior during these lifecycle events.

classes.name: BaseModuleActivator
classes.description: An abstract class that provides default (empty) implementations for the ModuleActivator interface methods, intended to be extended by modules that want to handle application lifecycle events.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Called when the application context is refreshed. Default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Called when the module has started. Default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Called when the module has stopped. Default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Called before the application context is refreshed. Default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Called before the module starts. Default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Called before the module stops. Default implementation does nothing.
